posts.t:
I got caught too!! I thought I was at supply.. and it was supply. But not THE supply! Anyway my entry was just wrong, since if it was a diamond I should have waited. One of my biggest failings...always too early.

But the AUD has been unreasonably

strong.. just another reminder that price can do anything it likes!

Anyway i did catch the GBPJPY at breakfast time monday morning for a QM in time, which you had helped me with. Whoo hoooo!! One of my first truly RTM trades with only a few pips drawdown.

I will journal it as an example of what I aspire to.

Dear All

Today was a great day. It was a bank holiday is South Africa so I decided to put away the charts and sped some quality time with the family. It is good just to chill sometimes. posts.t: Here is an update on my AU trade I took last week. I exited the trade early yesterday. The reasons for exiting the trade was as follows. 1) As I wasn't planning on trading the day I didn't want any open trades playing on my mind.. 2) We didn't break into the CPaz so I wasn't confident that price was going higher. 3) Although not great compression, it did look to me that price was compressed on the way up. 4) I was happy to take the profit, the one thing I've learnt at RTM is there is always another opportunity just around the corner.
posts.fa: این به‌روزرسانی معاملهٔ AU من از هفتهٔ گذشته است. دیروز زودتر خارج شدم. دلایل خروج: 1) چون قصد معامله در آن روز را نداشتم نمی‌خواستم معامله‌های باز ذهنم را مشغول نگه دارند.. 2) به CPaz نشکستیم پس مطمئن نبودم قیمت بالاتر می‌رود. 3) هرچند کامپرشن عالی نبود، به نظر من قیمت در مسیر بالا کامپرشن شده بود. 4) خوشحال بودم سود بگیرم؛ چیزی که در RTM یاد گرفتم این است که همیشه فرصت دیگری همان نزدیکی هست.

posts.t:
Thanks Harry I like your comments in IF's journal.

Well here's the reason I took this trade. Chart 1 shows the H4 view, I'm not sure if calling the blue boxes flags is correct (Maybe PAZ could be better), but we can see very distinctive blocks, and in the middle a great Flip zone

Chart 2 Shows the last break of the Flip zone and how price FO FTR 2 setting up a QM level.

Chart 3 Show the overview of the QM and a diamond at news time, perfect place for IT to turn price.

I2F
posts.fa:
ممنون Harry، نظراتت در ژورنال IF را دوست دارم.

خوب، دلیل این معامله: چارت 1 نمای H4 را نشان می‌دهد، مطمئن نیستم نامیدن جعبه‌های آبی «فلگ» درست باشد (شاید PAZ بهتر باشد)، ولی بلوک‌های خیلی متمایز می‌بینیم و در وسط یک ناحیهٔ فلیپ عالی

چارت 2 آخرین شکست ناحیهٔ فلیپ را نشان می‌دهد و اینکه چطور قیمت FTR 2 را FO کرد و سطح QM ساخت.

چارت 3 نمای کلی QM و یک الماس در زمان خبر را نشان می‌دهد، جای بی‌نقص برای IT که قیمت را بچرخاند.

I2F
